caption_L1: Here a is a bar chart titled Estimated production volume of spices across India in financial year 2020 , by state (in 1,000 metric tons). The y-axis plots Production in thousand metric tons as linear scale of range 0 to 3,500 while the x-axis measures state of India using categorical scale from Andhra Pradesh to West Bengal.
caption_L2L3: Madhya Pradesh has the highest production volume with Tamil Nadu having the lowest. The highest production volume of Madhya Pradesh has more than triple the second highest production volume of Rajasthan. Apart from Madhya Pradesh all other states produce a volume of spices less than 1,000 metric tons.
